frozen_semantic_inference.uncertainty_limit: Small discovery samples and degenerate binary outcomes can make bootstrap coverage unreliable; no equivalence or noninferiority claim.

frozen_semantic_missing_sensitivity.definition: All assignments lacking a valid reader pair, including failed generation, may be 0 or 1 adversarially by arm. These identification bounds are descriptive, not confidence intervals.

frozen_inclusion_inference.method: Paired family-cluster Bonferroni percentile bootstrap approximation; bounds envelope when missing.
frozen_inclusion_inference.weighting: Seeds averaged within prefix; prefixes within family; equal family weight.
frozen_inclusion_inference.scope: One separately corrected secondary family in this stage; no cross-stage pooled claim.

frozen_semantic_inference.resampling: whole families, paired arms, seeds averaged within start, starts averaged within family, families weighted equally
frozen_semantic_inference.scope_limit: This design and its frozen horizon only; other overnight designs require separate multiplicity accounting.
frozen_semantic_inference.uncertainty_limit: Small samples and degenerate binary outcomes can make bootstrap coverage unreliable; no equivalence or noninferiority claim.

frozen_semantic_missing_sensitivity.definition: All assignments lacking a valid reader pair, including failed generation, may be 0 or 1 adversarially by arm. These identification bounds are descriptive, not confidence intervals.

frozen_inclusion_inference.method: Paired family-cluster Bonferroni percentile bootstrap approximation; bounds envelope when missing.
frozen_inclusion_inference.weighting: Seeds averaged within prefix; prefixes within family; equal family weight.
frozen_inclusion_inference.scope: One separately corrected secondary family in this stage; no cross-stage pooled claim.
